source_scope: All 30 PRs returned by gh, all 30 pinned submission READMEs, PR bodies/comments, the pinned current leaderboard, and the current upstream submissions directory; local comparison status comes from the active work.

summary.completed_comparison_scope: Completed default and W2/B1 local studies against Rust #7, each with two valid pairs and one clock-invalid pair retained. Default study has no stable overall lead; W2/B1 failed its required all-three-pair acceptance and was not promoted.

conclusion: The completed default-configuration Rust #7 comparison does not establish a stable overall lead: two valid pairs yield 2.905% higher combined target CPU per success overall and inconsistent tails; pair 2 is clock-invalid and retained. The separate WORKERS=2 / ARTICLE_BATCH=1 screen is complete but NOT_ACCEPTED: pairs 1 and 2 have 5.0181% and 6.0277% lower whole-target CPU per success and lower p95/p99, with worse p50, while pair 3 has a clock-invalid Goose arm. All three valid passing pairs were required. Submitted defaults and source 3e908747 remain unchanged; promotion.patch was not applied. Portable/corrected Goose #31 remains unmeasured/proposal only; 26 active competitors have no performance comparison by us. No evidence establishes first place or superiority to every competitor.
source_pin_policy: Latest PR heads are pinned independently from historical measured revisions. Do not attach official scores to those exact heads without a measured-source witness. Pony #24 was explicitly scored at older a38283c. Self-reported hardware, durations, think scales and revisions differ; these numbers do not form a common speed ranking.
